                December 18 Last Day to Ship
                Priority Mail®
                December 19 Last Day to Ship
                Priority Mail® Express

                Send it with Love
                with USPS

                USPS has the supplies, services, and
                even gifts to help you pack it, seal it,
                & send it with love this holiday season.

                Explore More

                *Recommended send-by dates for expected delivery before December 25 in the contiguous U.S. (lower 48 states). Actual delivery date may vary and is based on origin, destination, Post Office acceptance time, and other conditions.

                Postmarks: If you want to ensure that your mail receives a postmark on the day you mail it, ask a retail associate at a Post Office retail counter to hand-cancel it for free. Learn more

                Featured USPS® Products & Services

                Ship from Home in 3 Easy Steps

                Use our online Click-N-Ship® service to pay for postage, print your own shipping labels, and schedule a free package pickup.

                Use Click-N-Ship

                Small Business Support

                Stay on track this season with USPS shipping services to help you meet your customers' holiday needs.

                Learn More about Small Business Solutions

                USPS Ground Advantage®

                USPS Ground Advantage is a great option for shippers of all sizes with delivery in 2-5* days and USPS Tracking® included in the price.

                Learn More about USPS Ground Advantage.

                *For mailable items up to 70 lbs. Expected delivery in 2-5 days. Packages going to certain places (including Alaska, Hawaii, and offshore destinations), or containing hazardous materials may receive slower service.

                USPS Hold Mail® Service

                If you're going out of town for 3–30 days, you can submit a USPS Hold Mail request online. We'll keep your mail safely at your local Post Office™ location until you return.

                Get Started with USPS Hold Mail Service

                Carousel Slides detailing Postal Store Promotions

                USPS Stamps

                Our stamps celebrate life, art, and culture. Find your favorites online.

                Stamp Pricing:
                Forever: $0.82 | Postcard: $0.65

                Shop Now

                Prepaid Supplies

                Make shipping easy with prepaid Priority Mail® boxes and envelopes. Order now to get mailing and shipping in no time.

                Order Prepaid Supplies Now

                Holiday Cards

                Send bold & colorful messages to friends and loved ones with our variety of greeting cards.

                Shop Now

                Holiday Gifts

                Add some sparkle to your tree with our USPS® ornaments. See our entire collection of special holiday gifts.

                Shop Now

                Board of Governors

                The U.S. Postal Service Board of Governors will meet in open session on Tuesday, November 10th at 10 AM ET at USPS headquarters.

                Learn More about Board of Governors meetings

                Upcoming USPS Holidays

                USPS will be closed on Wednesday, November 11th in observance of Veterans Day.

                See All Holidays

                New EU Requirements for B2C Shipments

                The European Union (EU) is introducing additional customs changes for shipments to countries following EU customs rules. Learn more about the new €2 handling fee and Product Identifier requirements.
